test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 18th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: The term “media literacy” in the passage most nearly means:
solution: The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. Critical understanding of media messages**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Media literacy** refers to the ability to critically analyze and interpret media messages, recognizing bias, misinformation, and underlying meaning. (मीडिया साक्षरता का अर्थ है – मीडिया संदेशों की आलोचनात्मक समझ।) • The passage highlights the importance of media literacy for avoiding misinformation and understanding digital content. • It is not just about using devices, creating content, or memorizing news, but about critical interpretation and understanding of what is communicated. Therefore, the correct answer is- Critical understanding of media messages [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Ability to use devices** (डिवाइस का उपयोग करने की क्षमता): This is digital literacy, not media literacy. • **Skill in creating content** (सामग्री बनाने में कौशल): Media literacy focuses on interpretation, not just creation. • **Memorizing news** (समाचार याद करना): Media literacy is about critical thinking, not rote memorization. 43:Td2f, The correct answer is **Option 3**.
